recap.text: Mordecai asks Quint, the club's pharmacist, whether the starter kit is still on offer, though Quint never expected anyone to afford one before the fifth or sixth floor. Two bottles of Rev-Up Moonshine appear on the table. Quint asks for four, the sleepy Donut holds out for three and the potion that stops the world being wavy, and the deal is struck. The suitcase is a large chest, filled to the brim with chemicals and herbs.

Mordecai tells Carl to set up his three tables in the empty crafting room and put everything labelled an alchemical supply on the alchemy table. Carl shoves the table against a wall and pulls everything in the alchemy category out of his inventory, from rat meat to the chest of supplies bought from the drug dealer. When he finishes, the simple table looks like a mad scientist has set up shop at a swap meet.

beats.headline: A suitcase for an empire
beats.text: You still offer the starter kit, Mordecai asks Quint, the club's pharmacist, who did not expect anyone to afford one until the fifth or sixth floor. Two bottles of Rev-Up Moonshine appear on the table. Make it four, says Quint. Three, says a sleepy Donut, and you give me the potion to stop the world being wavy. Deal. Carl asks what they are buying: a suitcase with everything you need to start your own pharmaceutical empire, says Quint. Just don't sell in his territory. Mordecai is putting together a library. The suitcase is actually a large chest, filled to the brim with chemicals and herbs.
beats.gist: Mordecai buys Quint's starter kit: four bottles of Rev-Up Moonshine, and a chest of chemicals and herbs.

beats.headline: Onto the alchemy table
beats.text: In the crafting room, still empty, Mordecai tells Carl to set up his three tables and leave everything labelled an alchemical supply on the alchemy table, and he will start on a few things. Carl shoves the table against a wall and pulls everything in the alchemy category out of his inventory, from rat meat to the chest of supplies they bought from the drug dealer. By the time he is done, the simple table looks as if a mad scientist has set up shop at a swap meet.
beats.gist: Mordecai has Carl set up three tables, and Carl piles every alchemical supply onto one.
